name: Docusign
description: Docusign is an electronic-signature and agreement-management platform for preparing, routing, signing, tracking, and retaining business documents. Organizations use it to coordinate agreement workflows and monitor the status of envelopes across people, teams, and systems.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Docusign user through Relay-owned OAuth and select one exact account, then let agents read approval-gated, bounded Envelope subject, status, and lifecycle timestamps without exposing participant identity or document content.

capabilities.label: Read envelope status
capabilities.description: Read bounded Envelope subject, status and lifecycle timestamps in one explicitly selected Docusign account.

approvalRequired.label: List recent envelopes
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five Docusign Envelope summaries changed during the previous fourteen days.

approvalRequired.label: List envelopes awaiting my signature
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five Envelope summaries in the connected user's awaiting-signature folder.

approvalRequired.label: Read an envelope
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Docusign Envelope summary subject to the provider's fifteen-minute polling rule.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every bounded Docusign Envelope read requires approval; participant identity, document content, signing, downloads, templates, administration and writes are outside Relay's V1 surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The three selected bounded Docusign reads run without Relay per-action approval; selected-account binding, redaction, bounds, audits, provider scopes and polling limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three typed Docusign Envelope read wrappers and attaches the encrypted OAuth token only to UserInfo and the validated selected-account regional API origin.
Relay mounts three typed Docusign Envelope read wrappers and attaches the encrypted OAuth token only to UserInfo and the validated selected-account regional API origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A Relay-owned Docusign integration key, Go-Live review, staging credentials, and live consent validation still require the separate provider-console task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create the Docusign integration key with Relay's exact HTTPS callback, request Go-Live approval, store staging client credentials, then verify PKCE S256, signature extended consent, UserInfo user/account/base-URI binding, serialized refresh replacement, upstream token revocation, all three bounded reads, the fifteen-minute exact-resource guard, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Docusign documents Authorization Code Grant, its account authorization and token endpoints, the exact redirect URI, PKCE, access-token exchange and refresh flow.
Docusign documents the signature and extended scopes used by Relay's bounded Envelope-read surface and refresh lifecycle.
Docusign documents resolving the authenticated user, account memberships, default account, account identifiers and regional base URI through OAuth UserInfo.
Docusign documents account-scoped Envelope status listing, date, count, order and folder filters used by the fixed bounded list wrappers.
Docusign documents reading one exact account-scoped Envelope; Relay exposes only redacted subject, status and lifecycle timestamps and enforces the provider polling guidance.
